a1-14.title: Communicative Challenge: Friends and People
a1-14.scenario: Anna asks you about the man standing next to Károly. He is András.
a1-14.prompt: Tell Anna he is András, a friend, then ask András where he lives.
cues: Say who he is and that he is a friend
a1-14.target: Ő András, egy barát. András, hol laksz?
a1-14.english: He is András, a friend. András, where do you live?
a1-14.canDo: I can identify someone as a man, woman, or friend using simple noun phrases.
